svg.text: Two comparable studies on the same 45,211-record dataset, sharing a split, a seed and a
preprocessing pipeline so the comparison means something.
Only 11.7% of records are positive, so predicting no for everyone scores 88.3% accuracy. The
study is built around refusing that number. I also dropped the duration feature, since call
length is only known once the call has ended and long calls are the ones that convert.
Best result: F1 0.4375, ROC-AUC 0.7910. Modest figures, and honest ones.
